# The Room by Kencho Group

> An interactive 3D living room and kitchen by Kencho Group, a custom furniture
> company in Tbilisi, Georgia (kitchens, wardrobes and furniture made to
> measure). The room is a showcase; the company's full site is
> https://www.kenchogroup.ge.

## What the room is

- Two ways in: the original black-and-white opening (a narrator and kinetic
  type) that ends in a realistic room in beige white and black, or the retro
  sketchbook that ends in a hand-drawn room in colour.
- The kitchen: change its finish (beige white and black quartz, sage and oak,
  forest green and walnut, warm white and honey oak, greige and graphite,
  retro terracotta), see each part's material, and look at it from five camera
  angles.
- The gallery wall: four kitchens Kencho Group has built.
- The workshop: a walk through the door to the About page.
